title: Hoop shot
description: Playable 45-second basketball shooting game (16:9) on real rigid-body physics: swipe or drag up to shoot (length = power, drift = aim) or hold Space to charge and release, the ball bounces off a trimesh rim and the backboard, swishes count only when falling through the net, a new spot after every shot, x2 / x3 streaks, best score saved, impact sounds, confetti, spotlit night arena, self-playing attract mode.
